# 20 — Capture evidence and lessons

## Objective
Create a complete human-reviewable activity record for the preceding work.
## Required context and areas
Use the actual conversation task, tool output, changed-file list, commands/results, and reviewer decision.
## Change constraints
Evidence files only. Do not invent dates, reviewers, commands, results, or acceptance.
## Response format
Complete `AI-ACTIVITY-TEMPLATE.md`; list missing fields separately.
## Assumptions
Mark unknown or not run explicitly; do not store confidential context.
## Validation and evidence
Run traceability validation if IDs changed. Confirm the record meets mandatory fields and note actual result.
